_readme: Hand-authored, same shape as data/dungeons.json (id/name/levelMin/levelMax), for the raid entries data/map-entrances.json references. Every original Classic raid (Onyxia's Lair, Molten Core, Blackwing Lair, Zul'Gurub, both Ahn'Qiraj wings, Naxxramas) is unambiguously a level-60 raid -- well-established, not guessed. The 6 new-in-Forever raids (the-tainted-scar, storm-cliffs, the-crystal-vale, nightmare-grove, scarlet-enclave, emerald-dream) have no confirmed level requirement anywhere in this project's data yet, so levelMin/levelMax are null rather than assumed -- don't fill these in without a real source.
